from pathlib import Path

answer = sum(n * n for n in range(1, 101))
expected = 338350
assert answer == expected, (answer, expected)
p = Path('.runtime/bus_code_roundtrip_20260930_e002.txt')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(f'{answer}\n', encoding='utf-8')
readback = int(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip())
assert readback == answer
print('BUS_CODE_EXECUTION=PASS')
print(f'WSL_ANSWER={readback}')

notes: Harmless WSL roundtrip test for this chat. Computes sum of squares 1..100, asserts 338350, writes and reads back the value in the isolated worktree, then prints WSL_ANSWER=338350.
